/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/aey-kufiyan-e-bewafa.md')
original = p.read_bytes()
front, source = original.decode().split('\\n---\\n', 1)
refrain = \"\"\"Ae Kufiyaan-e-bewafa
Ae zaalimo ahl-e-jafa\"\"\"
question = \"\"\"Hai tumheṅ khabar tum ho aashna
Kis ka ghar luta kis ka khun baha
Haaye tum ne ye kya kar diya
Kis ko lut kar ghar jala diya\"\"\"
hearts = \"\"\"Hai zabaanoṅ par kalma-e-Khuda
Phir bhi sinoṅ meiṅ dil hai sang ka\"\"\"
blocks = [
    \"\"\"Ghul machaate be adab wo Kufiyaan-e-bad zabaaṅ
Wahshatoṅ ke daairoṅ meiṅ thiṅ Ali ki betiyaaṅ
Zaalimoṅ ke saamne
Qaatiloṅ ke darmiyaaṅ
Chhoti dukhtar-e-Ali ki aa rahi thi ye sada
Husain\"\"\",
    \"Noha ye tha Kulsum ka\\nAe Kufiyaan-e-bewafa\\n\" + refrain,
    question,
    hearts + '\\n' + refrain,
    question,
    hearts,
    \"\"\"Us Husain ko qatl kar diya
Jis ke paas hai marzi-e-Khuda
Din jis ke ghar surkhru hua
Jis Husain ka naana Mustafa
Jis Husain ka baaba Murtaza
Jis Husain ki maaṅ hai Sayyida
Rubaru agar ho ga saamna
Kaise jaao ge pesh-e-Kibriya
\"\"\" + refrain,
    question + '\\n' + hearts + \"\"\"
Zulm kaun sa ham pe na hua
Phir bhi ham rahe raazi ba raza
Bhaai ko mere dhoka de diya
Saath na diya akela kar diya
Pehle khat likhe aur bula liya
Phir gharib ka khun baha diya
Mat zamin par tum bano Khuda
Waqt hai qarib ho ga faisla
\"\"\" + refrain,
    question + '\\n' + hearts + \"\"\"
Ae Kufiyo zulm ho gaya
Aal-e-Mustafa se muqaabla
Itrat-e-Nabi ham haiṅ bakhuda
Zer-e-aasmaan sar khula hua
Baandh kar hameṅ qaid kar liya
Aur phir hameṅ baaghi keh diya
Jis ke naana se din-e-haq mila
Us nawaase ko ye sila mila
\"\"\" + refrain,
    question + '\\n' + hearts + \"\"\"
Wa musibata
Wa musibata
Wa musibata yuṅ chaman luta
Gher kar hameṅ laaye Karbala
Band ham pe phir paani kar diya
Qatl kar diya ghar ka ghar mera
Sayyidoṅ ke sar kar diye juda
Zulm ki hui ham pe inteha
Tum pe waae ho haaye kya kiya
Ajr-e-Mustafa yuṅ ada kiya
\"\"\" + refrain + '\\n' + question + '\\n' + hearts,
]
preamble, *source_blocks = source.strip().split('\\n\\n')
assert preamble == 'اے کوفیانِ بے وفا'
assert len(blocks) == len(source_blocks) == 10
for i, (block, urdu) in enumerate(zip(blocks, source_blocks), 1):
    number, *verses = urdu.splitlines()
    assert number == str(i).translate(str.maketrans('0123456789', '۰۱۲۳۴۵۶۷۸۹'))
    assert len(verses) == len(block.splitlines()), i
roman = ['Ae Kufiyaan-e-bewafa'] + [f'{i}\\n{block}' for i, block in enumerate(blocks, 1)]
roman_text = '\\n\\n'.join(roman)
assert re.fullmatch(r\"[A-Za-z0-9ṅṄ \\n'-]+\", roman_text)
metadata, old_roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
metadata = metadata.replace('alternateTitle: \"Aey Kufiyan-e-Bewafa\"', 'alternateTitle: \"Ae Kufiyaan-e-Bewafa\"')
updated = metadata + 'romanLyrics: |-\\n' + '\\n'.join('  ' + line if line else '' for line in roman_text.splitlines()) + '\\n---\\n' + source
p.write_bytes(updated.encode())
saved = p.read_bytes()
assert saved.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1] == original.split(b'\\n---\\n', 1)[1]
print('Aligned physical verse lines:', sum(len(block.splitlines()) for block in blocks) + 1)
PY
git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/aey-kufiyan-e-bewafa.md"
